name: 00_boot
setup: g.__gpBoot = import('/src/systems/GameplayBoot.js').then(m => m.installGameplay(g, { seedDemo: true, quality: 'low' })).then(gp => { g.gameplay = gp; const base = g.step.bind(g); g.step = (dt) => { base(dt); try { gp.update(dt, null); } catch (e) { window.__GP_ERR = String(e && e.stack || e); } }; window.__GP_READY = true; }).catch(e => { window.__GP_ERR = String(e && e.stack || e); }); g.look(-24.0, 0, 27.4, Math.PI, -0.03);

name: 22_hands_reach
setup: if (!g.gameplay) return; g.gameplay.inventory.take('fuse_core', 1); g.gameplay.hands.setReaching(true, true); g.look(-20.0, 0, 22.0, Math.PI, -0.14);

name: 23_lamp_dying_in_dark
setup: if (!g.gameplay) return; g.gameplay.hands.setReaching(false); g.gameplay.qa.circuits(false); g.gameplay.qa.lamp(true, 0.10); g.look(-20.0, 0, 12.0, Math.PI, -0.06);

name: 25_breaker_thrown_dark
setup: if (!g.gameplay) return; g.gameplay.qa.circuits(true); g.gameplay.interactables.get('board_c').api.setWay('intake', false); g.gameplay.qa.lamp(true, 1.0); g.look(-25.2, 0, 21.0, 0, 0.02);

name: 30_surveyor_lit_full
setup: if (!g.gameplay) return; g.gameplay.qa.circuits(true); g.gameplay.qa.lamp(false); g.gameplay.qa.surveyorTo(-25.2, 12.6, Math.PI); g.gameplay.qa.pose(0.9, 0.4); g.look(-25.2, 0, 19.4, 0, 0.12);

name: 31_surveyor_scale_vs_player
setup: if (!g.gameplay) return; g.gameplay.qa.surveyorTo(-25.2, 21.4, Math.PI); g.gameplay.qa.pose(0.0, 0.0); g.look(-25.2, 0, 25.2, 0, 0.20);

name: 32_surveyor_frozen_midstride
setup: if (!g.gameplay) return; g.gameplay.qa.surveyorTo(-25.2, 14.0, Math.PI + 0.5); g.gameplay.qa.pose(1.55, 0.78); g.look(-22.6, 0, 19.2, 0.36, 0.12);

name: 34_surveyor_head_plate
setup: if (!g.gameplay) return; g.gameplay.qa.surveyorTo(-25.2, 17.4, Math.PI); g.gameplay.qa.pose(0.4, -0.5); g.look(-25.2, 0, 19.8, 0, 0.46);

name: 35_surveyor_down_the_spine
setup: if (!g.gameplay) return; g.gameplay.qa.surveyorTo(-25.2, 2.0, Math.PI); g.gameplay.qa.pose(2.2, 0.2); g.look(-25.2, 0, 21.0, 0, 0.02);

name: 36_surveyor_lamp_only
setup: if (!g.gameplay) return; g.gameplay.qa.circuits(false); g.gameplay.qa.lamp(true, 1.0); g.gameplay.qa.surveyorTo(-25.2, 15.2, Math.PI); g.gameplay.qa.pose(0.9, 0.25); g.look(-25.2, 0, 19.4, 0, 0.12);

name: 37_surveyor_capture
setup: if (!g.gameplay) return; g.gameplay.qa.circuits(true); g.gameplay.qa.lamp(false); g.gameplay.qa.surveyorTo(-25.2, 23.3, Math.PI); const s = g.gameplay.surveyor; s.captureBlend = 1; s.state = 'CAPTURING'; g.gameplay.qa.pose(0.2, 0.0); g.look(-25.2, 0, 25.2, 0, 0.34);

name: 40_attendant_footprints
setup: if (!g.gameplay) return; g.gameplay.surveyor.despawn(); const a = g.gameplay.attendant; a.minDistance = 0.5; a.frustumMargin = 0.1; g.look(20.0, 0, 40.0, 0, 0); a.act('footprints'); g.look(-21.0, 0, 21.5, Math.PI, -0.55);
